question: The Dronacharya Sports Award is given to the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Coach of the Team.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Dronacharya Award is given by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India, for excellence in sports coaching. 
 
• The award is known after Drona, often referred to as "Dronacharya" or "Guru Drona", a personality from the Sanskrit epic Mahabharata of ancient India.
 
• The Dronacharya Award contains a medallion, a certificate, and a money prize of Rs 15 lakh(lifetime) and 10 Lakh (regular).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
• Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award:

 
 
• It is the highest sporting award given by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports for the spectacular and top performance within the field of sports by a sportsperson.
 
• This award contains a medallion, a certificate, and a monetary prize of Rs 25 lakh.
 
 
 
• Arjuna Awards:
 
 
• This award is given by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India to acknowledge outstanding action in National sports.
 
• Instituted in 1961, the award carries a money prize of Rs 15 Lakh, a bronze sculpture of Arjuna, and a scroll.
